details.text: The questionnaire's constraint 2-format is not met: Invalid Visit Number (2a). Visit number must be exactly 6 alphanumeric characters.
The questionnaire's constraint tc-1 is not met: The value of myVar1 must be true.
The questionnaire's constraint tc-2 is not met: The value of myVar2 must also be true, based on myVar1.
The questionnaire's constraint tc-patient could not be evaluated (it refers to %patient, which is not available when validating a QuestionnaireResponse on its own), so it has not been checked
